luiskr.com / core/router/navigate / buildRouteJsonLd

function buildRouteJsonLd(to, canonicalOverride?, description?): Record<string, unknown>[]

Defined in: core/router/navigate.ts:137

Base JSON-LD entities for a resolved route — exported so views whose localized descriptions resolve post-navigation (home/about) can re-emit the graph with the real description instead of the parse-time fallback, and so rich views can append entities to the same base. canonicalOverride lets syncDocumentHead pass the URL it already computed for the so both stay identical.

Parameters

to

RouteDescriptor

Resolved route descriptor.

canonicalOverride?

string

Canonical URL; recomputed from to when absent.

description?

string

Description override (post-fetch localized text).

Returns

Record<string, unknown>[]

JSON-LD entity array for updateJsonLd().
